description: This file contains a test class 'SampleStreamingTests' that demonstrates and verifies various streaming scenarios in Orleans, including producer-consumer patterns, subscription orderings, inline consumers, and message delivery validation.

classes.name: SampleStreamingTests
classes.description: A test class demonstrating various streaming scenarios in Orleans, including producer-consumer interactions, subscription orderings, inline consumers, and message validation.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer
methods.description: Tests consumer subscribing before producer starts, verifying message delivery after producer begins.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Producer_Consumer
methods.description: Tests producer starting before consumer joins, verifying late-joining consumer receives messages.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Producer_InlineConsumer
methods.description: Tests streaming with an inline consumer that processes messages synchronously for lower latency.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Validates that the number of produced messages matches the number of consumed messages, ensuring no message loss or duplication.
